title: TimeProvider authorization scope is publicly rebindable after tracker binding
description: Security review: TimeProvider.allowed_sources is a public writable attribute. After a provider is bound into StratumTracker, callers can replace the frozenset and issue source classes outside the originally authorized scope. Store authorization scope privately/immutably and test that post-binding reassignment cannot expand authority.
notes: Also make the authority name immutable/private and have tracker validate or snapshot authority configuration at bind time; test post-bind mutation attempts.
